decisions.decision: Split Button into Button / ButtonLink / TextLink
decisions.rationale: Three Figma button types: Button=<button> for form actions, ButtonLink=pill <a> link, TextLink=underline <a> link (forest green, Figma node 424-60)
User wanted CTA as component; follows existing NavLogo pattern in global/

decisions.decision: Hamburger rotation via cumulative $state not CSS class toggle
decisions.rationale: CSS class toggle reverses direction on close; JS +45 state always rotates clockwise

decisions.decision: Mobile menu CTA pinned via position:absolute bottom:40px
decisions.rationale: position:absolute removes element from flex flow — always visible at bottom regardless of content height. Flex content needs padding-bottom to avoid overlap.

decisions.decision: Page transitions via View Transitions API (onNavigate)
decisions.rationale: SvelteKit-native, zero extra deps, degrades gracefully, fade-out 180ms + fade-in 280ms
